description.p: nit reviews pull requests and merge requests from Bitbucket Cloud, GitHub and GitLab. One inbox shows the pull requests that concern you; the review screen shows a fast, syntax-highlighted diff computed locally with git.

ul.li: Several accounts and forges in one inbox, cached for offline use
Inline, file and pull request comments written as drafts and posted after you confirm
Approve and request changes, checked against the current state of the pull request
Stacked pull requests detected, with advice on review and merge order
